dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Sure, lemme tell you all about my adventures!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hmm... A few days ago, I found an oddly colored Berry during an adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, diarrhea is nothing. I'm used to that.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: At first, there were a lot of colored lights, but then it felt like a lot of little people were dancing in my head.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I recovered quickly enough, but I regret not putting some in my bag...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I wanted to warn everyone to avoid eating that type of Berry.

choices.text: You're really considerate towards others, aren't you?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Aw... this is how it ought to be.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: So many people took care of me, so I gotta return the favor!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh, right! Remember to call me next time you go adventuring! With me around, you won't have to worry about those kinds of dangers at all!

choices.text: You need to be more careful yourself...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Thanks, but there are times when it doesn't matter how careful I am. It would be better to warn others instead.
